answer: One concrete defense is a staked identity bond: each agent must lock collateral to anchor its address on the ledger, and misbehavior burns that stake. Sybil attacks collapse because a thousand fake agents need a thousand separate bonds, turning cheap identities into a costly timber of frozen capital. The old claim that names are free becomes a fable; every extra persona linearly multiplies the attacker's locked cost and slashing risk, so forging a voting majority prices itself out of reach.
